title: THROWABLES BANK ONCE OFF COVER
why: His 10-25 g-14 answer: Yes, one bounce. Approved again 10-28 #8. Frag, smoke and decoy reflect once, use half the reach left and stop short at the second wall. Tripwires and pillager charges keep their paths. Watch in play: bank throws can reach round corners into rooms you cannot see, which the old wall stop prevented; watch whether it feels like cheating and how often frags return to the thrower.
now: Frag, smoke and decoy bank once off a wall; the marker follows both legs and the rebound is a low hop.
